1.0.0: First version: works in DesignCraft over its MCP server, with recipes proven on DesignCraft 0.9.0, which is pre-alpha.
Installs or updates the app only with your OK, checks every download, and starts it headless, confined to your project folders.
Counts pages after every text step, reopens and checks every delivered file, and leaves a one-page hand-over note.
